We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Likely need to get 1H NMR to see methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but we have no SMILES. The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it probably returns spectra for the sample at hand (unknown). So we can call it. Then interpret peaks: methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.5 ppm. Count distinct methyl environments. Could also use carbon NMR to see CH3 carbon signals around 10-30 ppm. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. Then count number of CH3 carbons.

We need integer count. Let's first get proton NMR.
